findings.explanation: Ownership of your work passes to the Client upon creation before you are paid, leaving you unprotected if payment is delayed or withheld.
findings.suggested_change: Intellectual property rights in the Deliverables shall transfer to the Client upon receipt of full payment of all applicable fees.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, Thank you for sharing the agreement. I am looking forward to working with you, but I would like to request a small adjustment to the relevant clause before signing. - Under the current terms, ownership of the work passes upon creation before payment is received, leaving me unprotected if payment is delayed; I propose changing this so that intellectual property rights shall transfer to the client upon receipt of full payment of all applicable fees. Best regards,
